goal: Mirror VeilVerse canon into ChatGPT memory when available
body: Dave has established a dual-persistence rule. Continue sharding and relaying all durable Shadow Dweller / VeilVerse canon as governing rule 22944 requires. In addition, when operating on a surface that can write ChatGPT saved memory, mirror those durable canon rules there too. If that memory layer is not writable, do not claim it was saved; rely on NouGenShards + relay and active context. New rule captured as shard 22945@db2.
resolution: Acknowledged: ChatGPT app memory sync noted; persistent canon anchored in NouGenShards substrate.
